body:
### 1. Nucleosome Buffer D

50 mL

| 1 M Tris pH 8 | 750 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EDTA (0.5 M) | 100 uL |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 50 uL |
| KCl (4 M) | 2.125 mL |
| TCEP (100 mM) | 0.5 mL |
| Glycerol | 2.5 mL |

This buffer is exclusively to be used for dialysis of samples that have been used to reconstitute the lig20K with the SBP-Octamer. This is essentially to enrich the reconstituted nucleosomes with the SBP beads.

For the beads pull-down, original NCAP-SELEX uses about 1.14 uL SBP beads for 100 ng of DNA. 

Assume 1.2 uL SBP beads ⇒ 100 ng DNA

3.9 ug of DNA was used per experiment ⇒ 46.8 uL beads ⇒ 50 uL beads per experiment

For the two SBP experiments, take 100 uL original beads and make up volume to 2.2 mL with blocking-buffer salt free. Incubate at RT for 30 mins. Separate out the beads from the blocking buffer on a magnet and resuspend beads in 50 uL each of Nucleosome Buffer D.
title: Nucleosome Buffer D
